notes.title: 1.3.16Omega3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Just a small update to improve how the game behaves with multi-monitor setups, and other UI navigation tweaks.
Stay tuned for our next update, which will rebalance rooms and furniture prices!

[h3]v1.3.16 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]The game remembers the last monitor it was placed on.
[*]The game window stays on the same monitor when turning into Windowed Mode in multi-monitor setups. 
[*]The Re-Roll button now appears when buying multiple rolls.
[*]You can navigate windows with scroll bars using the Arrow or WASD keys.
[*]A and D keys have been bound for room changing.
[*]Removed the S key binding for selling.
[*]Highlight mode won't trigger when opening Steam Overlay.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3.12 Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that could cause Golden Rolls to give a cat breed that you already have found as a kitten.

notes.title: 1.3.11 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where you could buy a Toy Exp or Toy Area upgrade while not meeting its cost, causing unreliable results in the wallet.
[*]Added stars rarity icons when buying a new roll.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3.1 Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that would make keyboard shortcuts unresponsive after skipping the last roll.

notes.title: 1.2.7 Changelog
notes.notes:
Just a small patch with some QoL changes:

[h3]v1.2.7 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added the Alt+Enter keyboard shortcut to toggle fullscreen mode.
[*]The Roll buttons are now clickable right away when opening the New Cat screen (instead of being clickable only after the fade-in animation ends)
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2.5 - The Details Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We're bringing some Quality of Life features on the Details card, together with a revamped Owned Cats screen and a new bulk-sell option. Let's take a look:

[h2]Roll and Discovery tooltips, Inspect button[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/fd3884da7e4ed9bcd8ee607d06d3815d3218bdf5.gif[/img]

When examining a cat, you now have two new icons, one identifying which Roll the cat is from, and the other telling you which variations of that breed you have already discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/509a765faecf261adc552bbd17823abe4063dcb8.gif[/img]

In the new Owned Cats screen, each cat card has a magnifying glass button that will make you further inspect the cat by jumping to their room and bringing up their details card.

[h2]New feature: bulk-sell[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/8d9eb657433b2e5915b76e5b453185b46c2037f2.gif[/img]

In need of a big clean up? You can now sell all grown cats (or just the ones who reached max level) with a couple of clicks! Just make sure to lock all the cats that you want to keep with you before that.


Last but not least, there's a new arrival in the catalog!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/101cb27e39d660c3fac23feb67911fb99040b7eb.png[/img]

[h3]v1.2.5 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]Details Card and Owned Cats Card: added an icon (with tooltip) to identify which Roll a cat is from.
[*]Details Card and Owned Cats Card: added an icon (with tooltip) to see whether the cat has been already discovered as Adult or Chonker.
[*]Owned Cats Card: added a button to go directly to that cat's room and open the Details Card.
[*]Owned Cats screen overhaul.
[*]New bulk-sell option in the Owned Cats Screen.
[*]When buying a new cat, a new line has been added to the bottom of the tooltip showing how many kittens of the same breed you currently own.
[*]New furniture: [i]Torii[/i] (Litter Box)
[*]Changing room style maintains the current furniture equipped, therefore the 20 cats limit has been removed.
[*]The Collection screen now shows the breed name if you have already discovered another variation.
[*]Save/Load code optimization.
[*]Added new cat names from the suggestions survey. Thank you!
[*]Updated the texture of disabled buttons.
[*]The Menu window has been slightly resized to avoid possible conflict between buttons.
[*]Added a border to the dropdown lists.
[*]Fixed the room hourly income tooltip.
[*]Equipping an already bought furniture/upgrade now plays the normal button click sound.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2.3 Hotfix
notes.notes:
A quick patch to address some issues with the new Grab feature!

[h3]v1.2.3 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an unintended behaviour that made you able to grab cats when a window was open, thus closing the window.
[*]Increased the timer duration before the grab mode is triggered to 0.4s (grab mode is triggered earlier only by moving the mouse away from the slot while holding down the left click).
[*]Added an option in the menu to toggle the Grab feature off.
[*]Added an option in the menu to toggle the positions shuffle back on.
[*]To make room for the new options, the menu screen has been resized and rearranged.
[*]The Income Tooltip now updates on room change.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.12 Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

We're still tweaking income values to make early game progression feel more satisfiyng, and they'll be ready for the next update. In the meantime, here are some small changes and a couple of features requested by the community:

[h3]v1.12 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]The task log has been reworded for clarity, since the streak system is not an actual streak anymore, but a cumulative tasks reward.
[*]Line-spacing in the tooltip during cat selection has been increased for better readability.
[*]You can now cycle between rooms using the left and right arrow keys, or by pressing the corresponding room's number (Thanks Gary Dozer).
[*]You can now sort cats by level in the Owned cats screen (Thanks Armanywright).
[/list]

See you soon for our next update!

notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

We're working to further improve our game, also thanks to the suggestions of our lovely community! Here's the changelog:

[list]
[*]Income from distractions is increased based on the amounts of rooms owned.
[*]Money reward from litter boxes is increased based on the amounts of rooms owned.
[*]The examine vertical card now has a galaxy background when selecting space cats.
[*]Space cats cards in the collection screen now have rainbow names.
[*]Fixed a bug where space chonkers sprites in the collection screen appeared as normal chonkers.
[*]Added new cat names from the suggestions survey. Thank you!
[*]Increased distraction spawn rate and adjusted trajectory in the Backyard Room Style (Thanks Chocolate Van Candy).
[*]Added an accessibilty setting that toggles a bigger outline on distractions (Thanks RoyalCorvids).
[*]Current money UI will appear while clicking distractions in Chill mode.
[*]Fixed a bug that made distractions under a text popup unclickable while in Chill mode. (Thanks Frambo).
[/list]
(Thanks Gary Dozer for the following suggestions)
[list]
[*]Purr sounds that play when selecting sleeping cats were very quiet and hard to hear, now they are louder.
[*]Moved cat sounds to a different audio track from sfx and added its own volume slider.
[*]Added a setting to mute only the toy sound.
[*]Cats stay awake for a few seconds after playing and gain one extra passive exp point during that time, but it wasn't pointed out anywhere. Now a text popup has been added to display this.
[*]Expanded the tooltip during cat selection from a roll: A discovered kitten will show you the exp required to grow, and a fully discovered breed will show Lv.1 income and sell value.
[*]Added a new tooltip for the collection screen showing exp to grow, income and sell value for discovered breeds.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.09 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're pretty confident to have found a solution for the bug that caused the very first daily task to not trigger the item reward correctly. For every new user, in case you still don't receive an item drop after your first daily, just restarting the game will fix that and drop your reward.

We're sorry for the inconvenience, and to compensate for it all current users who encountered the bug will receive an extra reward next time they launch the game.

Thanks for your continuous support, and we hope you're enjoying playing Chonkers!
[i]Alessandro[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230022/43964c3dfbf4fcec76fea660a6e4e80db6e62381.gif[/img]

notes.title: v1.07 Bugfix and Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

[b]First things first, let's address the elephant in the room. The Item Store is gone, dead, and it won't come back. Nobody, not even a necromancer, can resurrect it.[/b]

For those unaware of what I'm talking about, we added an Item Store with an EXP Boost and a Golden Roll (items that could be obtained [b]for free[/b] in-game) thinking it could offer a mean for our players to continuously support us and, at the same time, be rewarded with a modest boost in-game.

Unfortunately, the Item Store has been perceived as a paywall, and the fact that we intentionally avoided advertising the purchasable items (that could not be bought in-game, hence why the lack of the "In-App Purchases" tag) has been seen as we were trying to hide the shop instead.

Additionally, we encountered a bug that was blocking the in-game reward system and these items became unobtainable for many, and it surely didn't help building trust.

We are sorry for the confusion it might have caused and hope that our official statement will help you decide whether Chonkers is a game for you or not.

Said so, we are incredibly grateful for your feedback and the wave of love that Chonkers has been receiving!

[h3]v1.07 Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed (hopefully) a bug preventing Steam from triggering the reward item drop upon completing the first daily task. Successive tasks have already been tested and proven to trigger the item drop correctly.
[*] Added a setting to toggle the right mouse click, to be able to play with cats without needing to hold down the mouse button. (Thanks Kirilee from our Discord)
[*] Added an icon in the examination window to further signal when a cat is a chonker, same as in the owned cats screen. (Thanks OldFool2024 from our Discord)
[/list]

Thank you all for sticking with us, despite the initial hiccups 💖

Yours kindly,
Alessandro and Fabiano

P.s. Come chill with other Chonkers lovers in our [url=https://discord.gg/pAjdJJSJxa]Discord[/url]. We're waiting for your feedback, and you're welcome even if you're bringing a bug report with you!

notes.title: Chonkers Demo and release date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We've been working on this new game in the last few months, and we're hyped to share it with you! Chonkers is a cozy idle game where you can collect and play with many different cats while relaxing to great lo-fi beats. The demo is out right now, and the full game will be released very soon, on [b]December 11th[/b]. Check it out!
